criteria.notes: Provides a production-shaped destination directory and touch wayfinding flow for the supplied Veszprem map.
Keeps the supplied illustrated map dominant and draws routes against its real location and route-point IDs.
Bilingual visitor-centre hierarchy, map treatment, directory controls, and route details are domain-specific.
Primary instructions, destination names, route state, distance, and walking time meet room-readable floors.
Light, Dark, and Custom shell palettes preserve contrast without recoloring or obscuring the supplied map.
Long kiosk and destination names fit without clipped glyphs, overlap, or unreadable type reduction.
Both declared landscape sizes keep the map dominant and the directory usable without dead or overflowing regions.
The packaged SVG remains sharp, clickable IDs survive bundling, and route overlays align with source geometry.
This reference-led interactive map teaches graph routing and touch selection rather than reusing dashboard composition.

screenshots.notes: Full-HD directory composition, map detail, hierarchy, and scroll containment inspected.
Compact kiosk retains usable controls, readable rows, and a dominant uncropped map.
Connected route, endpoints, destination detail, distance, and reset action inspected.
Primary fixture matches the reviewed Full-HD default state.
Primary fixture matches the reviewed compact default state.
Custom palette changes every shell token while preserving map and text contrast.
Empty bound data produces a stable, actionable state without stale destinations.
Legend-only destinations are clearly marked off-map without inventing a route.
Live table replacement updates the visible destination directory cleanly.
Long bilingual rows remain contained and navigable inside the intentional scroll region.
Extended selected-place copy remains readable with clear route state and action placement.
Long kiosk labels fit the header without colliding with the current-location block.
Plain TABLE row-array input renders the same stable directory contract.
